sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Chamonix is an alpine and valley climbing destination in the Mont Blanc range.

sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: The source mix supports granite climbing in the Chamonix Aiguilles and valley climbing that includes granite, gneiss and limestone crags.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: The legacy packet treats Chamonix as a mixed area for multipitch, bouldering and sport-valley climbing rather than a single sport crag.
